title: Present perfect continuous: activity up to now
meaningZh: 从过去延续到现在的活动，或刚停止但仍有影响的活动
meaningEn: an activity continuing up to now or with a present result
explanation: 现在完成进行时用have或has been加-ing，强调过去开始、与现在相关的活动及持续过程。We have been packing parcels since nine可表示从九点一直忙到现在；说话时可能仍在做，也可能刚停下来。它不等于已经完成多少份；若强调数量结果，常改用现在完成时。
usage: 说明最近或持续进行的工作、等待与变化，交代现在疲惫、潮湿等状态的活动原因。
nuance: since引出起点，for引出一段时长。know等状态动词通常不用进行式；持续时长不自动证明工作已经全部完成。
structure: have / has been + -ing + since + starting point
formation: have / has been + -ing + since + starting point

examples.target: We have been packing parcels since nine.
examples.zh: 我们从九点开始一直在打包包裹。

examples.target: Mina has been checking the queue for half an hour.
examples.zh: 米娜一直在查看队伍，已经半小时了。

examples.target: I have packed twelve parcels today.
examples.zh: 我今天已经打包了十二个包裹。

examples.target: We have been delivering food this morning, so our coats are wet.
examples.zh: 我们今天上午一直在送食物，所以外套都湿了。

notes: 等级为教学编排，不代表官方穷尽语法清单。

commonMistakes.wrong: We have been packing parcels since two hours.
commonMistakes.correct: We have been packing parcels for two hours.
commonMistakes.explanation: two hours是一段时长，用for；since后接起点，如nine或Monday。

comparison.explanation: have packed twelve强调已完成的数量；have been packing强调活动过程，不承诺全部完成。

exercises.prompt: “We have been packing parcels since nine.” 主要强调什么？
acceptedAnswers: 从九点起持续打包的活动
exercises.explanation: 完成进行时强调活动过程；句子没有提供已完成总数。
options: 从九点起持续打包的活动

exercises.prompt: Mina has been checking the queue ( ) half an hour.
exercises.explanation: half an hour表示一段持续时间，应搭配for。

exercises.prompt: 你想报告今天已打包的确切数量，哪句更合适？
acceptedAnswers: I have packed twelve parcels today.
exercises.explanation: 完成时加数量直接报告结果；进行时强调忙碌过程。
options: I have been packing parcels today.
I have packed twelve parcels today.
I will pack twelve parcels next week.

exercises.prompt: 改正时长表达：We have been packing parcels since two hours.
acceptedAnswers: We have been packing parcels for two hours.
exercises.explanation: two hours为时长而非开始时点，因此将since改为for。

exercises.prompt: 译成英语：米娜一直在查看队伍，已经半小时了。
acceptedAnswers: Mina has been checking the queue for half an hour.
exercises.explanation: 单数Mina配has been checking；for引出持续时长。
